title: Signing in
html:
The system can be used by predefined users with specific permissions. Every user has a login name and a password.

System support and assistance by e-mail: infinity_support@orc.hu, or by phone through your personal contact person.

The language of the system can be selected before signing in. Infinity supports the following languages: Hungarian, German, English.

After signing in, the top right corner shows the user's name and the registered office or site the user is assigned to — with several sites, the one the user is signed in to.
